recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further Device/DeviceDefinition property wording cleanup should be handled under later property clarification issues rather than changing FHIR-26639's already-applied choice conversion.
issue_request: FHIR-26639 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by OO and requested rationalizing Device.property and DeviceDefinition.property by replacing separate valueQuantity and valueCode elements with a single value[x] choice because one property should have one value.
initial_application: Commit 5af20b6658ab34965b88e626e6052eb5b8c759a2 applied the conversion to Device. DeviceDefinition was still split immediately after that commit, but f7809084c6ff4cb26ba4773a2eadaab473e86641 later converted DeviceDefinition.property.valueQuantity/valueCode to DeviceDefinition.property.value[x] as part of the same property-modeling family. Commit 23d0f3c36f2244f7636e70edcfbd21cf074c49db later made the value mandatory on both resources.
additional_context: Current fhir.ini actively includes both Device and DeviceDefinition. FHIR-26424 is a later Published/Persuasive-with-Modification OO decision that explicitly approved the broader property.value[x] datatype set now present in source, so the current extra choices beyond Quantity and CodeableConcept should not be reverted under FHIR-26639. FHIR-32568 supports the later mandatory value cardinality, and FHIR-39322 is later clarification context for nearby definitions/comments.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source has Device.property.value[x] and DeviceDefinition.property.value[x], each 1..1, and no remaining old valueQuantity/valueCode element definitions in the active StructureDefinition files.
